caption: The drawing features a centrally positioned eagle with outstretched wings, rendered in shades of brown and gold with darker accents emphasizing the feather details. The eagle's head is turned slightly toward its left, and its claws are extended downward, gripping an arrangement of stylized leaves and floral elements, primarily shaded in muted green and brown hues. Integrated into the design are three large, circular holes; one positioned beneath each wing and one below the eagle’s body. Beneath the foliage, a vertical bundle of rods, resembling a fasces, is depicted in a similar color palette. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, with the scale "6 INCHES = 1 FOOT" and the name "ELMER G. ANDERSON" inscribed beneath the design in small capital letters.
title: Hose Holder for Hand Engine
